2609.00832.title: TWIX: a Two-Stage Approach for End-To-End Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction
2609.00832.paper_summary: The exponential growth of scientific publications calls for automatic Information Extraction (IE) systems to support knowledge discovery. In this context, the GutBrainIE benchmark evaluates Named Entity Recognition (NER), Named Entity Recognition and Disambiguation (NERD), and Relation Extraction (RE) systems in the gut-brain axis domain. We propose Two-stage Workflow for Information eXtraction (TWIX), an end-to-end IE pipeline featuring three interconnected modules, each leveraging a two-stage framework to solve all four GutBrainIE subtasks. Evaluation on the development and test sets shows that our method substantially outperforms the baseline by a wide margin, while also ranking first among all participant submissions across all subtasks. These results indicate that the proposed two-stage pipeline effectively improves both precision and recall in practical settings.
2609.00832.paper_summary_zh: 科學出版物的指數增長呼籲自動化資訊提取（IE）系統來支持知識發現。在這個背景下，GutBrainIE基準評估腸-腦軸領域的命名實體識別（NER）、命名實體識別與消歧（NERD）以及關係提取（RE）系統。我們提出了資訊提取的兩階段工作流程（TWIX），這是一個端到端的IE管道，具有三個相互連接的模塊，每個模塊都利用兩階段框架來解決所有四個GutBrainIE子任務。在開發集和測試集上的評估顯示，我們的方法在基準線上大幅超越，並且在所有子任務中所有參賽提交中排名第一。這些結果表明，所提出的兩階段管道在實際環境中有效提高了精確度和召回率。
2609.00832.author: Marco Martinelli et.al.
